target: same-feature same-linear-capacity relative-value and exact decision-focused training

methods.M0_original: absolute mean-squared loss; fixed original raw-alpha100
methods.M0_tuned: same M0 loss; same three regularization candidates fairness comparator
methods.M1: absolute-gap-weighted RankNet, fixed190 denominator then mean over questions
methods.M2: ListNet cross entropy, mean over questions
methods.M3: OOF Top3 competitor weighted squared gaps, 1/400 then mean over questions
methods.M4: exact epigraph convex SPO+ QP, lexicographic true argmax

model_selection.criterion: GSM8K and BBH equally weighted historical inner OOF actual routed accuracy
model_selection.ties: stronger regularization, then smaller M3 alpha or larger ListNet target temperature
model_selection.routing_ties: original exact numpy argmax, first lexicographic action

sensitivity.M3_top5: reuse selected Top3 alpha and regularization
sensitivity.M4_uniformtie: reuse selected lexicographic regularization; uniform average over true reward-maximizers
sensitivity.shuffled_control: one fixed task/subtask-block permutation recipe within each legal fitting region; frozen selected hyperparameters; no retuning
sensitivity.shuffle_oof: one regional permuted dataset, plain OOF holds its current reassigned reward block out

calibration.mapping: one nonnegative scalar slope and shared intercept, no clipping, all20 outputs
calibration.fit: selected historical inner-OOF scores and original historical mean rewards

statistics.resampling: paired original questions within outerfold x task strata, all methods and3 repeats attached
statistics.primary_weights: GSM8K50% BBH50%, BBH internally by question
statistics.pvalues: two-sided centered paired-bootstrap Monte Carlo test, plus-one correction
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across exactly two primary objective comparisons
statistics.evidence_scope: conditional reused-development cross-validation with overlapping training histories

metrics.primary: real aggregated correctness at raw-score argmax
metrics.pair_rank: true nonzero mean gap, numerical predicted tie within1e-12 earns half credit; question average and support reported
metrics.competition: common outer M0_original predicted Top3; any pair touching that set
metrics.selection_loss: max three-repeat empirical mean minus selected empirical mean, not population regret

stopping: positive primary Holm-controlled evidence required for next-phase protocol only; no automatic feedback execution
